modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: On all Jet2.com flights each passenger (excluding infants) has a 10kg hand luggage allowance included as standard.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 piece of hand luggage no larger than 56cm x 45cm x 25cm, including wheels and handles.

carryon_weight.value: Up to 10kg, included on all Jet2.com flights (excluding infants).

personal_item.value: 1 small under-seat bag, such as a handbag or laptop bag, up to 40 x 30 x 20cm that fits under the seat in front.

busy_flights.value: On busy flights Jet2 may ask you to put your 10kg hand luggage in the hold, unless you have added Guaranteed Cabin Luggage.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Hold baggage is an add-on: you can add up to three 22kg bags per person per flight (excluding infants).

hold_bags.value: Up to three 22kg hold bags can be added per person per flight (excluding infants).

children_items.value: Infants get an extra 10kg allowance, and up to two items per child or infant (such as a pushchair, car seat, baby carrier or travel cot) travel free; each item must weigh no more than 32kg.

sports_equipment.value: Bikes and golf bags can be added for an extra charge; maximum 32kg for bikes and 22kg for golf bags.
